scenarios.name: weekend_freeze
scenarios.description: NAV stamped Fri 2026-11-13 15:55 ET (just before the close); evaluated Sun 2026-11-15 11:30 ET. Market closed the whole weekend: freeze is not staleness.

scenarios.name: open_market_fresh
scenarios.description: NAV stamped Wed 2026-11-18 10:15 ET, evaluated same session 11:00 ET: 45 minutes of open-market age, well within the 4h bound.

scenarios.name: open_market_stale
scenarios.description: NAV stamped Mon 2026-11-16 15:00 ET, evaluated Wed 2026-11-18 14:00 ET: it has sat through 1h (Mon) + 6.5h (Tue) + 4.5h (Wed) = 12h of live trading without updating -> stale.

scenarios.name: holiday_freeze
scenarios.description: Bonus: NAV stamped Wed 2026-11-25 15:55 ET; evaluated Fri 2026-11-27 09:00 ET (pre-open on the early-close day). Thanksgiving Day (Thu) the exchange was closed, so the quote is still fresh.
